changelog_html:
1.5.0

  • Every price now comes from the 2026 Bulk Rates sheet instead of the Faire product export.
  • Bulk minimums apply to the whole order in any combination of fruit, as the rate sheet states, rather than to each fruit separately.
  • Adds the 60 lb and 360 lb price breaks, grapefruit whole as its own SKU, and a line naming the next price break.
  • Says bulk rather than wholesale throughout; the primary button reads "Start a bulk order".

1.4.1

  • The plugin updates itself: WordPress checks the release manifest on GitHub and shows the standard update notice when a new version ships.
